text: Maya: Quick design check: new batch preview now shows a compact "relevance" column with caret sort UI. A few things from QA: (1) sort control doesn't announce direction to ATs, (2) export options are confusing (CSV vs NDJSON), and (3) when toggling dense mode the row controls shift and keyboard focus gets lost. Attachment: screenshot+recording. design-bot: ui-build-4899 uploaded: https://ci/internal/4899/preview.mov Olivia: Thanks. For (1) we need aria-sort on the column header and an aria-live notice when sort changes ("Sorted by relevance, descending"). Also the visible caret is too small on high-DPI, propose 14px hit area. Jamal: Implementation note 14: aria-sort="ascending|descending|none" is easy. For the live region we can use props that updates. I'll add keyboard handlers for Enter/Space to toggle sort. Ankur: Accessibility nit: the caret icon lacks an accessible name. Use aria-label="Sort by relevance" and manage aria-pressed for toggle state. Screen readers expect explicit labels. Samira: On export formats 14 some customers want embeddings as NDJSON for downstream eval pipelines, others want CSV for quick Excel checks. Current dropdown shows "Export vectors" only. Suggest expanding to a split button: Primary action = "Download CSV" with secondary menu: "Download NDJSON (for eval)", "Download CSV (id,embedding,metadata)", "Copy to clipboard". Olivia: I like split button. Visual copy: primary should be "Download CSV"; tooltip: "Includes id, embedding, metadata. Use NDJSON for newline-delimited JSON GC pipelines." For mobile the split menu can be inline list to avoid two-button layout. Maya: QA found CSV header ordering surprises. Proposal: default CSV columns: id, query_id (if present), score, embedding_0..N, metadata.*. Samira: agreed but preserve predictable ordering. Add sample header in tooltip. Jamal: I'll wire sample header like: ``` id,query_id,score,embedding_0,embedding_1,...,metadata_source,metadata_user ``` Jamal: Also adding format param to API call: format=csv|ndjson, include_metadata=true|false. Backwards compatible default = csv+metadata. Ankur: Keyboard flow: propose a single-key shortcut (D) to download last-selected row's vectors when focused in preview, with a focusable badge that toggles. Must be configurable and documented in the keyboard shortcuts modal. Add accessible hint: "Press D to download vectors for selected item" when preview opens. Samira: Edge-case: when multiple rows are selected for batch export, the D key should open the export menu instead of starting a download. UX decision: D for single-item quick-download, Shift+D for batch export? Thoughts. Olivia: Shift+D for batch feels OK. But mention in tooltip that Shift+D triggers batch export. Also ensure modifier keys are visible in the keyboard help overlay. Maya: Visual: when dense table toggled, action column compresses icons and hides the label. That hides affordances. Suggest keeping minimum 32px icon buttons and move labels into a hover-expanded area. Jamal: I'll implement a CSS variable --action-min-width: 32px and a hover popover for labels. For screen reader users we keep the labels via sr-only text. Ankur: For dynamic relevance scores we should expose delta changes with role="status" so AT users know when rerank completes: e.g., "Relevance updated for 3 items". Also ensure the update is not overly chatty. Debounce updates to once per render cycle. Samira: Export filenames: include context: e.g., vectors--.csv or .ndjson. People copy these into storage and need deterministic names. Also allow user-provided prefix in export modal. Olivia: Good call. We'll add an input for prefix with placeholder "vectors--2026-03-23" and show final preview. Add small copy: "Filenames are safe for S3 and analytics ingestion." Maya: Tiny UX polish: selected-row highlight color is very close to the export CTA on the row actions. Increase contrast or add subtle outline when focused. Jamal: Will change selected-row tint to var(--interactive-bg-2) and add focus outline for keyboard nav: 3px solid var(--focus) with offset. Ankur: Also please ensure column resize handles are 10px hit area and have aria-labels like "Resize column relevance". They currently are purely visual. Samira: After changes, can we run a 5-user quick test focusing on: (a) download flow CSV vs NDJSON understanding, (b) keyboard shortcuts D/Shift+D behavior, (c) screen reader announcement for sort and updates? I can schedule with research. Olivia: I'll land a mock with split button, updated caret sizes, aria-labels, and export filename preview by EOD. Will add a11y checklist to the PR: aria-sort, aria-live for changes, focus management, tooltips for truncated metadata. Maya: Thanks all. Once PR merges let's verify with a quick staging run and close. :rocket:
